new_statements.quote: g. Posición del acento: Este rasgo delimita una zona OESTE que se comporta distinta en función del acento, el cual recae sobre la vocal final en la variedad OESTE, mientras que recae en la penúltima para las otras variedades. [Tabla 9. Diferenciación por posición del acento — diez: OESTE makué / NORTE makói / CENTRO makói / CUMBRE makói / SUR mkó; culebra: sinuí / sinówi / – / – / sinówi; hormiga: sikuí / sikúi / sikúi / sikúi / sikuí] ... [Cuadro 5] Norte: Sisoguichi, Narárachi, Carichí, Ocórare, Pasigochi y Norogachi
new_statements.translation: g. Position of the accent: this feature delimits a WEST zone which behaves differently with respect to the accent, which falls on the final vowel in the WEST variety, whereas it falls on the penultimate [vowel/syllable] in the other varieties. [Table 9, differentiation by accent position — 'ten': West makué / North makói / Centre makói / Cumbre makói / South mkó; 'snake': sinuí / sinówi / – / – / sinówi; 'ant': sikuí / sikúi / sikúi / sikúi / sikuí] ... [Chart 5] North: Sisoguichi, Narárachi, Carichí, Ocórare, Pasigochi and Norogachi.

new_statements.second_reader_evidence: QUOTE: Opened (299 pp., text layer). PDF page 45 = printed p.27, cap.1 sec.1.3.1 item (4g): 'g. Posición del acento: Este rasgo delimita una zona OESTE que se comporta distinta en función del acento, el cual recae sobre la vocal final en la variedad OESTE, mientras que recae en la penúltima para las otras variedades.' followed by Tabla 9 (diez: makué / makói / makói / makói / mkó; culebra: sinuí / sinówi / – / – / sinówi; hormiga: sikuí / sikúi / sikúi / sikúi / sikuí) and Cuadro 5 ('Norte: Sisoguichi, Narárachi, Carichí, Ocórare, Pasigochi y Norogachi') — all verbatim as the first reader quoted (the bracketed table rendering is faithful). The passage is explicitly Villalpando's summary of…
new_statements.rule_in_words: In the CET (1992) dialect survey the 'Norte' variety patterns with Centro/Cumbre/Sur against Oeste on a stress isogloss: in the diagnostic words (makói 'ten', sinówi 'snake', sikúi 'ant') Norte has penultimate stress where Western Tarahumara has final stress. This is a lexically restricted isogloss note, not a general word-stress rule; general descriptions of neighbouring Alta-Tarahumara varieties (Brambila 1953:245 Norogachi, itself a CET-'Norte' locality; Caballero 2022 Choguita) describe lexically contrastive stress confined to an initial three-syllable window.
new_statements.exceptions: None; only three lexical items are given, and the Norte cell is filled for all three.
new_statements.domain_note: Isolated citation forms from a dialect-survey wordlist; statement is comparative (Oeste vs the rest), reported second-hand by Villalpando from the unpublished CET 1992 report. CET/INALI 'Norte' = Sisoguichi–Narárachi–Carichí–Norogachi area (INALI additionally lists Guerrero municipality: Arisiachi, Tomochi, La Nopalera), i.e. wider than and not identical to Ethnologue/Glottolog thh (Ariseachi group).
new_statements.identity_note: Glottolog nort2956 carries ISO thh = Ethnologue 'Northern Tarahumara / Ariseachi Tarahumara': Santa Rosa Ariseachi, Agua Caliente Ariseachi, Bilaguchi, Tomochi, La Nopalera (Guerrero municipality, Chihuahua; Glottolog coordinates 28.46,-107.80 sit by Tomochi); 300 elderly speakers in 1993, 'may be extinct'. The only stress statement found concerns the CET 1992 / INALI 2008 'tarahumara del norte' (ralámuli raicha Norte), a much wider unit sampled at Sisoguichi, Narárachi, Carichí, Ocórare, Pasigochi and Norogachi (Bocoyna/Carichí area; INALI also lists the Guerrero-municipality thh localities under it). Most of that area is Central Tarahumara [tar] in Ethnologue/Glottolog terms (Caballero 2022: Ethnologue Central = INALI Central + Norte; Norogachi is ISO tar). No first-hand linguistic description of the Ariseachi/Tomochi communities themselves was located.

Posición del acento: Este rasgo delimita una zona OESTE que se comporta distinta en función del acento, el cual recae sobre la vocal final en la variedad OESTE, mientras que recae en la penúltima para las otras variedades. [Tabla 9. sources.locator: cap. 1, §1.3.1 'Criterios lingüísticos delimitantes', item (4g) 'Posición del acento' and Tabla 9, p.27; Cuadro 5 (CET 'Norte' localities), p.27
sources.note: §1.3.1 item (4g) p.27 + Tabla 9 reproduces the CET (1992) Chihuahua dialect-survey isogloss 'Posición del acento': stress falls on the final vowel in the OESTE variety 'mientras que recae en la penúltima para las otras variedades' (NORTE column: makói 'diez', sinówi 'culebra', sikúi 'hormiga'). Cuadro 5 (p.27): CET 'Norte' area = Sisoguichi, Narárachi, Carichí, Ocórare, Pasigochi, Norogachi. Second-hand, lexically restricted isogloss statement; the thesis itself describes Turuachi (Southeastern, tcu).
